name: Women's USAF-style mess dress: general officer sleeve braid overlay (1 1/2 in, 2 1/2 in from the sleeve end)
size_basis: Same artwork box and scale as garment-mess-dress-female. Braid 1.5 in wide per CAPR 39-1 4.1.2.1 (the sleeve end is 2.5 in below its lower edge). Mess dress braid tone: lighter blue taken from the dress's own satin shawl collar (line #2c4a96, band #18306e, edge #0a1740 against the coat #001c52, about 3.6x the coat luminance), not the tonal Class A look, because the tonal braid could not be seen on the mess dress (Doran D37). Drawn as 0.04 in lines on a 0.1 in pitch.
landmarks_note: polygons are [[x,y]...] in user units (0.01 in)

sleeve_braid.rule: lower edge parallel to the drawn cuff edge and 2.5 in from it (CAPR 39-1 4.1.2.1), measured perpendicular to the cuff edge; ends cut on the sleeve outline and on the sleeve inner edge as in the officer overlay

documented: 1 1/2 in blue sleeve braid for general officers (4.1.1.1 / 4.1.2.1)
assumed: braid colour: not specified as a shade; lighter blue from the dress's satin shawl collar so it can be seen on the coat, Doran D37 (see base-art/braid-art.js)
1 1/2 in braid edge nearest the sleeve end set at the same distance as the 1/2 in braid
